scope: Qualitative category evidence; not AERLOR customer testimonials or proof of revenue impact.

sources.title: Packing hair products
sources.note: Contributors describe choosing between packing familiar tools and relying on hotel dryers. Other contributors are happy to use the hotel dryer or simplify their routine. These are self-selected anecdotes, not a representative survey.

sources.title: What hair styling tools do you take traveling?
sources.note: The original poster describes a familiar styling tool as too bulky for travel. Replies differ on whether and what to pack.

sources.title: Travel mirror recommendations please
sources.note: A traveller asks about a mirror for use while the bathroom is occupied, then explains that room mirrors can be poorly lit or difficult to approach.

sources.title: Hyatt Centric announces Drybar collaboration
sources.note: Hyatt announced an in-room premium dryer rollout in 2016. This is category precedent, not evidence about current availability at every hotel or AERLOR performance.

sources.note: The operator lists a lighted makeup and shaving mirror. It is not an AERLOR customer or endorsement.
